notes:
A fix for the **Redirect Health Check**: a page redirecting to itself would be found and reported, but ticking the group and hitting Fix selected didn't stick — the loop came straight back the next time the file saved, and on a two-page consolidation cycle the fix actually turned one loop into two. Loops now clear and stay cleared, and any already sitting in a file repair themselves on the next save without the check being run at all. Redirects you typed by hand are still never touched.

Also fixed: on a multi-site consolidation, a redirect from one site to the same path on another (`alpha.edu/about` to `beta.edu/about`) was wrongly reported as a page redirecting to itself.

If you have an audit with consolidations in it, this one is worth taking before you hand the file over.
